item.title: Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimisation with Learned Inertia for Neural Architecture Search
item.description: We propose an adaptive particle swarm optimisation method that learns the inertia weight with a small neural network. Experiments show it outperforms genetic algorithms and random search on three neural architecture search benchmarks. Our method reduces search cost by 40 percent.

item.title: A Sinhala Language Model for Low-Resource Machine Translation
item.description: We present a transformer language model for Sinhala trained on a new dataset. Fine-tuning improves machine translation between Sinhala and English by 4 BLEU on a public benchmark.
